assemblyOrder: Complete internal face/FFC and cap fastening with both external USB cables unplugged.
Insert SC0727 Micro-B from above using the verified top entry corridor. Keep its USB-A female end free.
Insert complete27mm4472 USB-C from behind along verified axis. Keep its USB-A male end free.
Shape both loose cables around the declared radius guides without tension; bring USB-A male into free female body before fastening any cable restraint.
Only after final connector seating, install removable restraint; do not use USB sockets to carry the free coupling weight.
To open cap, release restraints and unplug both external board connectors first; full harness is not carried through cap closure.
